text_block_list.text:
—The new year has begun. This year brings 
the Classic tier. There is far more to 
accomplish than last year.

I want to be of even more help to Wonder 
Acute. As I braced myself with that 
thought...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Trainer. Congratulations to ya.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I brought something good right away~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Here's some New Year's money for you. Go 
buy whatever you like~♪
choice_data_list: Sorry, I really can't accept this...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...Oho?

I want to be of help, so taking money and 
goods from them instead leaves me no place 
to stand.

When I told Wonder Acute that accepting it 
would violate Tracen Academy's rules as 
well as social etiquette...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Is that so... And here I thought you'd be 
pleased. How lonely.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I even made the little envelopes for the 
New Year's money myself, you know. 
Carefully folding that pretty paper and 
all...
choice_data_list: Then can I just have the bag?!
Then just give me the bag!

text_block_list.text:
I accepted only the handmade New Year's 
envelope, and the matter was settled.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer, um, so I've reached 
the... Classic year now, haven't I~?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That turf girl from my class was really 
"hustling" out there... Don't I need to 
"hustle" too?

"The Classic Year is just as important for 
dirt Umamusume as it is for turf 
Umamusume."

The "Japan Dirt Derby" held in the summer, 
in particular, is the festival every dirt 
Umamusume strives for.

I want to somehow manage to enter the race 
and achieve a great result...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll have to do my best so I don't 
lose to the other girls in my class.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Still, what should I work hard on...? 
Trainer, what do you think this old lady 
should do this New Year's?"

Something to have them do for New 
Year's... If I were to give them a task, 
what comes to mind is...
choice_data_list: I'm working hard at not working hard!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, what the young folks are doing~. 
Wonder if an old-timer like me could do it 
too?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, there was an 
extraordinarily stylish Umamusume in my 
class. Maybe I could ask her to teach me?

An exceptionally stylish Umamusume. That 
girl was—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, good work~ Acute-san, were you 
thinking of getting your nails done or 
something?

"Tosen Jordan." She is Tracen Academy's 
resident gyaru Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"K, lemme see your nails. I'll check out 
their shape and decide what kinda style we 
should go for."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My nails... It's kind of embarrassing, 
honestly.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Regret, you say? Hohohoho...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, tiny! Super tiny! Acute-san's nails, 
aren't they just too cute?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"It's super cute, but painting it might be 
rough. Guess I'll just zone in and get it 
done, y'know?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Acute-san, do you want to try it yourself?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Mmhmm, sewing and beadwork are my 
specialties, after all. Well then, 
together the two of us~.

Patience was poured into applying designs 
onto tiny fingernails. The two spent their 
New Year's completely serious and focused.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trying hard not to try hard... That sounds 
almost like philosophy or a Zen riddle, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Still, let's give it a try. Let's see, 
what's something where I wouldn't have to 
try hard...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Low-effort cooking is the way to go after 
all. New Year's dishes that you can make 
without breaking a sweat and keep for 
days~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Guess I oughta bring some over for 
Trainer too."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Here we go, all done~ Radish cakes♪ I've 
also prepared sauces in all sorts of 
flavors passed down through generations of 
my family~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Polynesian flavor, and extra-cream flavor. 
Of course, there's sweet red bean paste 
too~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Guess I'll spend New Year's just taking it 
easy, nibbling on this as I relax.

We spent a relaxing time enjoying the 
various traditional flavors that Wonder 
Acute had inherited.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Huh, tactical variety...? Is that, like... 
some kind of bamboozlin' technique?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I feel like there 
was a fellow classmate who knew a lot 
about that sort of thing..."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hoh... Acute, was it you who wanted to 
challenge me to a game of cards?

This Umamusume is Nakayama Festa. She's 
known far and wide as an outlaw gambler.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: "Fine by me. So, what're the rules?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Rules? The only one I really know is Old 
Maid, you see.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Old Maid, is it...? Very well. It is the 
perfect game for psychological warfare.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you get in on this too. It's a 
three-way showdown.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, that's my win! Looks like I take 
this one...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What?! Impossible?! The Old Maid is 
supposed to be in your hand...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, I threw that away just a bit ago. 
Since I already got a matching set, you 
see."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm an old maid for drawing it, too. Since 
that makes a pair of Old Maids, you know.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... What a naturally airheaded 
nature... I shouldn't underestimate you.

I surprise Nakayama Festa using some 
grandmotherly wisdom. Afterward, we played 
together as she taught me various 
psychological tactics.
